title: Certified Branch Reductions for the Binary Covering Number K_2(11,3)
description: Technical report, software, and authenticated proof records for the binary covering-code cell K_2(11,3). Exact structural certificates and a complete normalized partition close 112 of 150 normalized branches, leaving 38. Within four selected hard third-word children, checked RUP and DRAT certificates close 324 of 350 exhaustive fourth-word branches, leaving 26 and closing no complete child or normalized parent. The exact value remains open and the known interval 15 <= K_2(11,3) <= 16 is unchanged.
